description: Concave versus convex surface charge of amphiphysin (positive control), ACAP1 and ACAP3 BAR dimers, using a centre-of-curvature definition of the membrane-facing surface
code:
import numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
Z=np.load("bar_models.npz"); meta=json.load(open("bar_models_res.json"))

def analyse(key):
    SC=Z[key+"_sc"]; CA=Z[key+"_ca"]; res=meta[key]
    aa=np.array([r[2] for r in res])
    q=np.where(np.isin(aa,list("KR")),1,np.where(np.isin(aa,list("DE")),-1,0))
    C=CA.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(CA-C,full_matrices=False)
    pcCA=(CA-C)@Vt.T; pcSC=(SC-C)@Vt.T
    ext=[float(np.ptp(pcCA[:,i])) for i in range(3)]
    cands=sorted([(abs(np.polyfit(pcCA[:,0],pcCA[:,k],2)[0]),k) for k in (1,2)])
    k=cands[-1][1]
    co=np.polyfit(pcCA[:,0],pcCA[:,k],2); a,b,c=co
    xv=-b/(2*a); O=np.array([xv, np.polyval(co,xv)+1/(2*a)])
    P2=np.stack([pcSC[:,0],pcSC[:,k]],axis=1)
    Cl=np.stack([pcCA[:,0],np.polyval(co,pcCA[:,0])],axis=1)
    inward=np.linalg.norm(Cl-O,axis=1)-np.linalg.norm(P2-O,axis=1)
    Dn=np.linalg.norm(CA[:,None,:]-CA[None,:,:],axis=2); nb=(Dn<10).sum(1)-1
    surface=nb<=np.median(nb)
    return dict(pc1=pcCA[:,0],inward=inward,q=q,surface=surface,aa=aa,res=res,
                extent=[round(e,1) for e in ext],radius=round(abs(1/(2*a)),1))

labels={"amph":"Amphiphysin BAR dimer (1URU)\npositive control",
        "acap1":"ACAP1 BAR dimer (4NSW crystal)",
        "acap3":"ACAP3 BAR dimer (AlphaFold on 4NSW)"}
out={}
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.9),sharey=True)
for ax,key in zip(axes,["amph","acap1","acap3"]):
    d=analyse(key)
    s=d['surface']
    hi=np.percentile(d['inward'][s],66.7); lo=np.percentile(d['inward'][s],33.3)
    face=s&(d['inward']>=hi); conv=s&(d['inward']<=lo)
    nK=int((d['q'][face]==1).sum()); nD=int((d['q'][face]==-1).sum())
    cK=int((d['q'][conv]==1).sum()); cD=int((d['q'][conv]==-1).sum())
    out[key]=dict(extent_A=d['extent'],curvature_radius_A=d['radius'],
      concave_n=int(face.sum()),concave_KR=nK,concave_DE=nD,concave_net=nK-nD,
      convex_n=int(conv.sum()),convex_KR=cK,convex_DE=cD,convex_net=cK-cD,
      concave_minus_convex_net=(nK-nD)-(cK-cD))
    print(f"{labels[key].splitlines()[0]:<40} dims={d['extent']} R_curv={d['radius']} A")
    print(f"    concave n={face.sum():3d}: K/R={nK:2d} D/E={nD:2d} net={nK-nD:+3d} | "
          f"convex n={conv.sum():3d}: K/R={cK:2d} D/E={cD:2d} net={cK-cD:+3d} | "
          f"concave minus convex = {(nK-nD)-(cK-cD):+d}")
    # list the concave basic residues
    cb=[f"{d['aa'][i]}{d['res'][i][1]}" for i in np.where(face&(d['q']==1))[0]]
    print(f"    concave Lys/Arg: {', '.join(sorted(set(cb)))}")
    col=np.where(d['q']==1,"#2166ac",np.where(d['q']==-1,"#b2182b","#d9d9d9"))
    ax.scatter(d['pc1'][~s],d['inward'][~s],c="#f4f4f4",s=12,edgecolor='none')
    ax.scatter(d['pc1'][s],d['inward'][s],c=col[s],s=38,edgecolor='none')
    ax.axhline(hi,color='k',lw=0.8,ls='--')
    ax.set_title(labels[key],fontsize=10); ax.set_xlabel("position along BAR long axis (A)")
axes[0].set_ylabel("side chain displacement toward\ncentre of curvature (A)")
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
axes[2].legend(handles=[Line2D([],[],marker='o',ls='',color="#2166ac",label="Lys/Arg"),
                        Line2D([],[],marker='o',ls='',color="#b2182b",label="Asp/Glu"),
                        Line2D([],[],marker='o',ls='',color="#d9d9d9",label="neutral surface"),
                        Line2D([],[],marker='o',ls='',color="#f4f4f4",label="buried")],
               loc="lower right",frameon=False,fontsize=8)
fig.suptitle("Surface charge of BAR dimers; concave (membrane) face lies above the dashed line",y=1.0,fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
json.dump(out,open("bar_concave_charge_v3.json","w"),indent=1)
